claim: G29 R4: native recovery-operation comparison may select a uniquely supported transient explicit Nemotron preload after retained on-demand startup crashes; exact post-trial unload and unchanged candidate qualification are mandatory, and at most two new model products may be rendered.
non_claims: No persistent LM Studio setting change, remote model, qwen retry, G30 mock result, live Mattermost contact, credentials, adapter activation, production readiness, promotion, or complete Soul cognition. A successful preload does not imply a valid candidate.
rationale: R3 uniquely selected the unused local Nemotron resource, but both on-demand requests terminated during startup and correlated with new LM Studio crash dumps. No model remained loaded. A 16K/full-GPU estimate is 25.18 GiB on a 48 GiB host and the actual prompts need far less than 8K context. A finite explicit load with 8K context and speculative MTP disabled changes the observed runtime condition while remaining reversible and avoiding persistent settings.
reading: Retain unchanged controls and ledger. Reread the R3 plan/outcome; attempt-301 exact error streams, timings, crash metadata, load estimate and empty post-state; R2 exact candidate/test consequences; model profile; WORK_PROTOCOL effect/recovery constraints; and ACCEPTANCE G29/G30.
representation: Recovery-operation atoms separate model, startup mechanism, context, GPU disposition, speculative mode, TTL, reversibility, changed evidence and authority. Native set comparison returns selected or unresolved standing. Preload/unload process observations remain mechanical evidence. Candidate products, resource standing and qualification observations remain separate.
consumer: G29 MeTTa owns operation comparison, whether a request may proceed, repair targets, assembly, qualification and continuation. Prolog invokes the exact allowlisted local CLI operation, captures state/process evidence, transports local requests, quarantines source, and runs syntax/tests. JavaScript freezes and independently verifies only.
falsifiers: Order changes recovery selection; removal still loads; equally supported operations first-match; load uses another model, larger context, persistent configuration or no TTL; inference proceeds after failed preload; exact model is not unloaded; baseline model state changes; calls exceed two; or invalid/credential-bearing/direct-core/test-failing source qualifies or is promoted.
scope_review: One transient explicit Nemotron load and exact unload, plus at most two nemotron-local generation claims at 2048 output tokens, 300 seconds and 2 MiB each. Context 8192, full GPU, speculative MTP disabled, TTL 900. No persistent setting, remote model, qwen, credential, Mattermost network, production activation, push, user-service stop beyond unloading the exact model this experiment loaded, or hand-authored candidate repair.
rollback: R1-R3 evidence and call claims remain immutable. If preload fails, unload if necessary and stop without generation. If generation fails, preserve exact streams and unload. R4 writes only new G29 evidence/runtime quarantine and G29 tooling. No candidate promotion or core modification.
